name: fix-component-implemented-by
body:
source: reconciliation finding that 15 solution components (embedded-assets, renderer, file-watcher, deck-validator, deck-loader, slide-parser, markdown-validator, cli-commands, deck-page, templates-gallery, release-workflow, scoop-manifest, homebrew-formula, install-docs, native-e2e-ci) had no implemented-by edges; inconsistency: solution tier did not trace to code; resolution: linked each to scanned code/File nodes that survive plan phase 7. Phase-7 delete targets (assets.Fonts/Logo/Templates/Starter, fonts/logo/templates/starter dirs, theme.css, template.Builtins/builtinTemplates, theme.Builtin/Default) were deliberately NOT used. [autonomous]

AMENDMENT (hybrid coverage fix) — source: `apg plan verify` derived coverage failed because several implemented-by targets are code this project never changes (plan-writer analysis); inconsistency: implemented-by on unchanged code cannot be covered by any plan task; resolution: removed exactly these implemented-by edges: cli-commands→cmd/eypres.main; deck-loader→internal/deck.LoadSlides; deck-page→internal/server.NewDeckPage; deck-validator→internal/validate.Format; embedded-assets→internal/assets.Pages and →internal/assets.Reveal; homebrew-formula→Formula/lib/github_private_release_download_strategy.rb; scoop-manifest→bucket/eypres.json; install-docs→INSTALL.md; markdown-validator→internal/mdcheck.Check and →internal/mdcheck.ExtractLinks; slide-parser→internal/slide.Parse; theme-registry→internal/theme.NewRegistry. All other implemented-by edges kept. scoop-manifest, markdown-validator and slide-parser are now intentionally without implemented-by; linking unchanged components to their code is deferred to a separate spec-completeness project. [with user]
